notes.title: Update Version 1.1
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

  We're extremely happy to see you are enjoying the game with VR, please, reach out to us on the Community Hub if you have any questions about the game.

Changelog:
[list][*]Improvements to sounds effects
[*]Added more instructions to the tutorial level
[*]Lockers now open immediately
[*]General improvements to the lighting
[/list]

  Thanks for your interest in Stealth Labyrinth!
